title: Armor_plus
description: This mod adds new armor and tools. Which are crafted from vanilla materials(emerald, redstone, coal and so on).
body:
## Armor Pluse
Have you ever wanted to create armor or tools out of lapis lazuli or emerald? Now with this mod, it's possible. The mod adds armor and tools that are crafted from vanilla materials (Emerald, Redstone, Obsidian, and so on).


Thank rek1nchik for creating some textures
